question: Simplify (5³ times 27 times 10³)/(5⁶ times 3² times 4)
solution:
Given : 

(5³ times 27 times 10³)/(5⁶ times 3² times 4)

Concept Used 

**Indices law**

 
 

 Multiplication rule with same base
 pn ⋅ pm = pm + n
 
 

 Multiplication rule with same indices
 pn ⋅ yn = (p ⋅ y)n
 
 

 Division rule with same base
 pm / pn = pm - n
 
 

 Division rule with same indices
 xn / ym = (x / y)n
 
 

 Power rule
 (an)m = an.m
 
 

 Negative power rule
 p-n = 1 / pn
 
 

Calculation :

(5³ times 27 times 10³)/(5⁶ times 3² times 4)

⇒(5³ times 3³ times (5×2)³)/(5⁶ times 3² times 2 ²)

⇒frac{5⁽³⁻⁶⁾ times 3⁽³⁻²⁰⁾ times 5³ times 2 ³}{ 2 ²}

⇒{5⁽⁻³⁾ times 3⁽¹⁾ times 5³ times 2 ⁽³⁻²⁾}

⇒{5⁽⁻³ ⁺³⁾ times 3⁽¹⁾times 2 ¹}

⇒6 

The required value of (5³ times 27 times 10³)/(5⁶ times 3² times 4) is 6.
